questions.question: What is Zionix?
questions.answer: Zionix is an elegant, modern Christian spiritual platform designed for daily Scripture study, devotional reflection, communal prayer, and gospel exploration. It bridges timeless biblical truths with a peaceful web experience.

questions.question: What features are available on Zionix?
questions.answer: Zionix provides five primary features: 1) Daily Bread & Morning Reflections, 2) Comprehensive 66-Book Bible Explorer with search, 3) Interactive Community Prayer Wall with privacy controls, 4) Gospel Clarity & Foundations, and 5) Searchable Theological Topics.

questions.question: Who is Zionix for?
questions.answer: Zionix is designed for both believers seeking daily spiritual nourishment and discipleship, as well as seekers exploring the foundational truths of Christianity.

questions.question: Where can I read the Bible?
questions.answer: You can read the entire Bible using Zionix's full-screen Bible Explorer. It includes all 66 books across the Old and New Testaments with chapter-by-chapter navigation.

questions.question: Can I search the Bible?
questions.answer: Yes! Zionix features a lightning-fast full-text search engine in the Bible Explorer that lets you search any word, phrase, or scripture reference across all 66 books instantly.

questions.question: How many books are available in the Bible Explorer?
questions.answer: All 66 books of the Holy Bible are available—39 books of the Old Testament and 27 books of the New Testament.

questions.question: Can I read the Old and New Testaments?
questions.answer: Yes. You can switch effortlessly between the Old Testament and the New Testament, pick any book, and flip through chapters seamlessly.

questions.question: Can I change the reading text size?
questions.answer: Yes, the Bible Explorer includes responsive typography controls so you can increase or decrease font size for comfortable reading on mobile, tablet, or desktop.

questions.question: How do I find a specific Bible verse?
questions.answer: You can select the book and chapter directly from the Bible Explorer menu, or use the top search bar to type keywords or book references.

questions.question: How can I submit a prayer request?
questions.answer: You can submit a prayer request on the Prayer Wall at /prayer-wall. Choose a category (like Healing, Family, or Guidance), type your petition, and choose whether to make it public or private.

questions.question: Can I make my prayer private?
questions.answer: Yes. Zionix provides confidentiality toggles. You can mark your request 'Private', which means it will not appear on the public wall and will only be shared with the core pastoral team.
followUps: Can other people see my prayer?
What happens after I submit a prayer?
How can I submit a prayer request?

questions.question: Can other people see my prayer?
questions.answer: Only if you mark it 'Public'. Public requests appear on the community Prayer Wall so other believers can stand in agreement with you. If marked 'Private', it remains confidential for the pastoral team.
followUps: Can I make my prayer private?
What happens after I submit a prayer?

questions.question: What happens after I submit a prayer?
questions.answer: When you submit a request, an automated email notification is dispatched to the prayer team so they can intercede for you. If marked public, other believers on Zionix can also pray for your request.

questions.question: Can the community pray for my request?
questions.answer: Yes! Marking your prayer request as 'Public' publishes it to the community Prayer Wall, where visitors can read and join in agreement with your burden.
